description: Spencer and Ashley try to build a real relationship under family scrutiny while grief, injury, music, new relatives and competing romances make privacy and stability increasingly difficult.

s02e01-02.description: Spencer and Ashley wake to a changed relationship while loss, injury and an unexpected family connection reshape several lives at once.

s02e03.description: Ashley confronts pressures surrounding her music and family history while Spencer tries to work out where she fits in Ashley's increasingly complicated world.

s02e04.description: Spencer brings the realities of her relationship into a family setting where acceptance, discomfort and old expectations all arrive at the same table.

s02e05.description: Spencer and Ashley try to define their relationship while jealousy and competing loyalties make even basic rules difficult to agree on.

s02e06.description: Spencer's family life shifts in an unexpected direction, forcing her to reconsider the roles her parents have always occupied.

s02e07.description: The difference between private identity and public disclosure becomes unavoidable as Spencer and Ashley face pressure from friends and family.

s02e08.description: A destabilizing event hits the group and exposes how fragile several relationships have become beneath their attempts to appear settled.

s02e09.description: People Spencer thought she understood reveal new motives, while emotional distance proves less reliable than everyone has been pretending.

s02e10.description: Romantic loyalties turn combative as the group struggles to separate genuine affection from rivalry, pride and old resentment.

s02e11.description: A recording and its consequences complicate already unstable relationships, forcing several characters to confront what others now know.

s02e12.description: Aiden becomes the center of overlapping romantic complications while Spencer and Ashley confront problems that cannot be solved by simple reassurance.

s02e13.description: The season closes with relationships under strain and the characters discovering that getting what they wanted has not made life simpler.
